title: Convert parse failures with `?` in fetch_once
description: `fetch_once` now leans on `?` for the parse step instead of an explicit `map_err`, and a `From<ParseError> for FetchError` impl is added next to the call site so the conversion lives in one place. Parse failures on this path come from bodies that arrived over a flaky link, so the conversion produces `FetchError::Transport` carrying the parser's message.
